title: precursor source schema
description: A chemical precursor delivered into the chamber, as used in chemical vapor and atomic layer deposition. The delivery mechanism is what sets the parameters that matter, e.g. a bubbler has a vessel temperature and a carrier flow.

delivery.description: How the precursor is brought into the chamber.

vesselTemperature.description: Temperature of the precursor vessel, which sets its vapor pressure.

carrierGasId.description: Identifier of the gas source carrying this precursor.
